ننتبه (form VIII)
# نَنْتَبِهُ (nantabihu) /nan.ta.bi.hu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# نُنْتَبَهُ (nuntabahu) /nun.ta.ba.hu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# نَنْتَبِهَ (nantabiha) /nan.ta.bi.ha/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# نُنْتَبَهَ (nuntabaha) /nun.ta.ba.ha/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
